title: Old Saxon / Old Low German Universal Dependencies corpus
summary: Machine-readable historical-language syntax corpus preserving Old Saxon / Old Low German forms and syntactic annotation.
semantic_integrity: Original forms and normalized/annotated representations must remain distinguishable; historical language identity is not collapsed into modern German.

title: Sea Ice Extent & Concentration v2, 1850–present
summary: Versioned sea-ice record combining historical observations with modern satellite observations, preserving a long observational lineage.
semantic_integrity: Historical observations, reconstruction methods, and satellite-derived measurements are distinct evidence layers; version changes are preserved rather than treated as overwrite.
canonical_identifier: NSIDC Sea Ice Extent & Concentration v2

title: IMP-6 LANL 2-minute plasma data
summary: Legacy spacecraft plasma measurements including temperature anisotropy and alpha/proton ratio with persistent SPASE identity.
semantic_integrity: Instrument identity and measurement cadence are retained as provenance; later derived products must not replace the original observation layer.

title: TOLNet / NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory lidar observations
summary: Lidar atmospheric observations spanning 2015–2026 with persistent NASA identifier and instrument lineage.
semantic_integrity: Observation, calibration, processing, and derived atmospheric products are tracked as separate layers.
provenance: NASA Earthdata / NOAA Chemical Sciences Laboratory

title: Sentinel-1D Single Look Complex SAR observations
summary: 2026 Sentinel-1D SAR observation lineage supporting Earth-surface, glacial, tectonic, and geomorphic analysis.
semantic_integrity: Acquisition identifiers and processing lineage are preserved so future derived analyses can be distinguished from source observations.

title: Harvard University Herbaria: All Records
summary: Digitized specimen records stewarded by Harvard University Herbaria, spanning former component collections and a global specimen base exceeding five million physical specimens.
semantic_integrity: Historical collection identities remain distinguishable; digitized occurrence records are not treated as equivalent to the physical specimen.

title: Multilingual Cloud Corpus of Bangladesh
summary: National-scale multilingual corpus covering 42 language varieties with 85,792 structured entries and approximately 107 hours of annotated audio; 14 varieties are described as endangered.
semantic_integrity: Language varieties are preserved as documented varieties; translation, IPA transcription, and English/Bengali stimulus material are distinct evidence layers.

title: Boletim da República de Moçambique — Cold Archive
summary: Cold archive of 13,541 distinct PDF artifacts with 13,248 resolved publication references and 45 unresolved identities preserved separately.
semantic_integrity: Unresolved publication identities and conflicting metadata are retained rather than silently resolved; extracted text remains derivative of the source PDF.

title: NIR-SORT textile spectroscopy and microscopy dataset
summary: Known-provenance and real-world textile measurements spanning benchtop and handheld NIR instruments plus optical microscopy, with machine-readable metadata and uncertainty documentation.
semantic_integrity: Specimen provenance, instrument identity, transformed measurements, and model outputs remain separate layers.

title: Trinity College Dublin Herbarium
summary: 85,651 herbarium specimen records published as a Darwin Core Archive with monthly updates.
semantic_integrity: Occurrence records remain linked to specimen context and collection identity.

title: Bhutan National Herbarium specimen records
summary: Newly registered Bhutan National Herbarium specimen datasets published through GBIF with Darwin Core source archives and multiple identifiers observed.
semantic_integrity: Multiple GBIF registrations are tracked by DOI and source archive rather than collapsed solely by title.

title: Vittorio Marchesoni's Herbarium
summary: Historical herbarium from the Sibillini Range, collected 1948–1963, purchased by the University of Florence in 1963 and physically transferred there in 2018; a duplicate is held elsewhere.
semantic_integrity: Collection custody and duplicate-series identity are preserved as separate provenance facts.

title: PRA Herbarium Dataset
summary: Institute of Botany of the Czech Academy of Sciences herbarium dataset, version 1.4, published September 22, 2026.
semantic_integrity: Dataset version and specimen record identity are retained independently.
provenance: Institute of Botany of the Czech Academy of Sciences

title: Organological databases and repositories — critical source catalogue
summary: Critical catalogue and structural atlas of 53 registered organological source keys plus constituent score collections and audit-only resources, with dated evidence register.
semantic_integrity: The catalogue explicitly distinguishes source keys from constituent collections and preserves source dependence and editorial responsibility.

title: Trait-record scientific references v2
summary: Versioned 8.7 MB TSV dataset of scientific works cited by trait records, released as Zenodo v2.
semantic_integrity: Reference identity is preserved as a separate evidence layer from the trait records that cite it.

title: U.S.-Wide Sentinel-2–USGS River Suspended Sediment Matchup Dataset
summary: 25,474 quality-passing Sentinel-2/USGS suspended-sediment matchups from approximately 1,170 monitoring sites across the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii.
semantic_integrity: Satellite observations, in situ measurements, matchup criteria, and quality flags remain separate evidence components.

title: Acer L. specimens held in the KOR Herbarium
summary: First published portion of the KOR Acer collection, digitising preserved Acer specimens accumulated through field collecting and exchange; the release is intended to expand as additional specimens are digitised and verified.
semantic_integrity: Specimen records remain distinguishable from the physical collection and from future expanded releases.
provenance: Institute of Dendrology, Polish Academy of Sciences

title: USAC, CECON, Herbario USCG
summary: September 2026 publication update for Guatemala's USCG herbarium, established in 1923 and holding more than 47,000 specimens across plants, lichens, macrofungi and bryophyte groups.
semantic_integrity: Historical collection identity and current digitization status are retained separately from occurrence records.
provenance: Universidad de San Carlos de Guatemala

title: Herbier régional d'Occitanie (TL 111)
summary: Digitized regional herbarium dataset focused on the French Pyrenees, published September 15, 2026 through GBIF France.
semantic_integrity: Regional scope is preserved; it is not conflated with broader Toulouse or French herbarium aggregates.

title: Fungal Collection of Nature Research Centre (BILAS): Gasteroid fungi
summary: Complete digitized set of well-preserved gasteroid-fungi specimens in the BILAS herbarium: 67 species in 20 genera, from a collection established in 1948 with approximately 650 gasteroid-fungi specimens represented.
semantic_integrity: Historical specimens, taxonomic names and later identification literature remain separate evidence layers.

title: Aura MLS Averaging Kernel files v6.0 Rev. B
summary: Versioned Aura Microwave Limb Sounder averaging-kernel package. Revision B corrects filenames and slightly modifies profile selection so files better match their stated latitudes.
semantic_integrity: Filename correction, profile-selection change and underlying retrieval data are explicitly separated; prior versions remain meaningful provenance.

title: Size-harmonized atmospheric microplastic observations and constrained simulation outputs
summary: Open release containing size-harmonized atmospheric microplastic observations plus constrained and unconstrained simulation outputs, with NetCDF, CSV, sensitivity and trace files; total release size is about 1.7 GB.
semantic_integrity: Observed measurements, harmonized observations and simulation outputs are retained as distinct evidence layers; the release records upstream dataset/software dependencies.

title: Kubitzki et al. trait records v2
summary: Version 2 dataset transcribing and parsing trait information from the Families and Genera of Vascular Plants monographs; records combine manual transcription, automated landmark detection, review and OpenRefine processing.
semantic_integrity: Manual transcription, parsed taxon descriptions and reviewed transformations are treated as separate provenance stages.

title: SARS-CoV-2 infections in Germany
summary: Robert Koch Institute version dated September 26, 2026 containing district-level reported SARS-CoV-2 infections, deaths and recoveries differentiated by age and sex for epidemiological assessment.
semantic_integrity: Reported surveillance observations, aggregation level, demographic stratification and downstream epidemiological interpretation are kept distinct.

title: FeederBW: real-world energy data from 200 low-voltage feeders
summary: Real-world German low-voltage distribution data from 200 feeders over 2023–2025, with weather, one-minute resolution and metadata on low-carbon technology installations.
semantic_integrity: Feeder measurements, weather covariates, infrastructure metadata and derived analyses remain distinct.

title: AlmaSDG: dataset of scientific articles' contributions to the UN Sustainable Development Goals
summary: Multi-annotator pilot dataset labeling scientific articles across all UN Sustainable Development Goals, with inter-annotator validation and model/tool inference benchmarks.
semantic_integrity: Human annotations, agreement measurements, model inference and SDG interpretation are separate evidence layers.

title: Hepatic Vessel Map (HVM) expert-annotated CT dataset
summary: Dual-center contrast-enhanced CT dataset from 282 patients with fine-grained annotations of hepatic veins, portal veins through third-order branches and liver tumors.
semantic_integrity: Patient-level source data, anatomical annotations and downstream AI models are distinct layers; access constraints must be preserved.

title: HISTONCHO intervention histories for onchocerciasis control and elimination
summary: Historical intervention dataset covering onchocerciasis control in sub-Saharan Africa from 1975–2022, assembled from ESPEN, country/regional reports, partner records and published literature.
semantic_integrity: Reported interventions, reconstructed chronology, source documents and later modeling are kept separate.

title: Curated and integrated global bee–plant interactions dataset
summary: Refined subset of GloBI focused on bee–plant interactions, with updated taxonomy and metadata for geography, endemism and human plant uses.
semantic_integrity: Interaction observations, taxonomy updates, geographic metadata and human-use annotations remain separately attributable.

title: GWTC-3 O3b compact-binary parameter-estimation data release
summary: Posterior-sample HDF5 data for compact-binary candidates from the second part of LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA observing run O3, preserving parameter-estimation evidence associated with GWTC-3.
semantic_integrity: Posterior samples, candidate identities, catalog-level interpretation and later reanalysis are distinct layers.

title: COKI Open Access Dataset 2026-09-23
summary: JSONL open-access performance dataset covering 225 countries and 50,000 institutions, produced from a multi-source Academic Observatory pipeline.
semantic_integrity: Source observations, synthesis calculations, country/institution aggregates and dashboard representations remain distinct.
provenance: Curtin University Centre for Culture and Technology
